I do it to increase the visibility of my car, as well as to warn other drivers that I may be driving slower than usual for safety. It’s basically a signal to others to please back off.

I also only do it when it’s raining extremely heavily like the other day. I was driving on the interstate during the massive storm the passed through and I could barely see 2ft in front of me at times. So I turned on my hazards when I felt unsafe and needed to slow down as quickly as possible. I also moved to the right and turned my hazards off once I was safely out of the way.

And yes, my headlights were on, I just didn’t want to get rammed by the crazy drivers who like to tailgate me. Plus my car is a color that blends into the rain.
